items.fact: Art 145(3): an Art 143 reference is heard by at least five judges; the Court may decline to answer (Ismail Faruqui, 1994).

items.label: Art 200 proviso — Money Bill cannot be returned

items.label: Art 356 — Parliament approval within 2 months
items.fact: Art 356(3): proclamation approved by both Houses within two months; then six months at a time; outer limit three years (with conditions after one year).
items.sources: standard reference (Constitution of India / official site)

items.label: Art 12 'State' ≠ government servant
items.fact: 'State' under Art 12 means bound by Part III and amenable to writs; it does not make employees government servants.
items.sources: standard reference (Constitution of India / official site)

items.label: Art 22(3) exceptions — enemy alien, preventive detention
items.fact: Art 22(3): clauses (1) and (2) do not apply to an enemy alien or a person arrested/detained under a preventive-detention law; 22(4) Advisory Board beyond 3 months.

items.label: Bonded labour SOP (Surendra Manjhi, 2 Nov 2026)
items.fact: 2 Nov 2026: SC (Vikram Nath, Aparesh Kumar Singh JJ), Surendra Manjhi v UoI, 2026 INSC 1185 — uniform revised SOP for identification, release and rehabilitation of bonded labourers: release certificate ordinarily within 24 h, immediate aid within 7 days, rehabilitation plan within 90 days; writs kept pending

items.label: Forex reserves $717.06 bn (wk to 30 Oct 2026); CPI Sept 5.54%
items.fact: RBI weekly data (released 6 Nov 2026): reserves fell $2.691 bn to $717.056 bn in week ended 30 Oct 2026 (FCA $591.118 bn); record $785.706 bn (week ended 4 Sept 2026). CPI (base 2024) Sept 2026 5.54% (Aug 4.83%), food 7.74%; RBI target 4% ±2 (RBI Act s. 45ZA)
items.sources: Business Standard weekly policy watch 9 Nov 2026

items.label: APEC 2026 leaders meeting, Shenzhen (18–19 Nov)
items.fact: APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting 18–19 Nov 2026, Shenzhen, China (host Xi Jinping; China's 3rd time after 2001, 2014); theme "Building an Asia-Pacific Community to Prosper Together"; APEC founded 1989 Canberra, 21 member economies, secretariat Singapore; India not a member
items.sources: Wikipedia APEC China 2026; PR Newswire 5 Nov 2026

items.label: Art 352 one month vs Art 356 two months (approval)
items.fact: Parliamentary approval: Art 352 within 1 month (special majority), Art 356 within 2 months, Art 360 within 2 months; each extension 6 months; Art 356 max 3 years; beyond 1 yr needs emergency + ECI certificate

items.label: B. P. Singhal (2010) — Governor removal not arbitrary
items.fact: B. P. Singhal v UoI (2010, 5 judges): President's pleasure under Art 156 not unfettered; Governor cannot be removed arbitrarily or for disagreeing with Union policy; limited judicial review

items.label: Fake AI precedents void NCLT/NCLAT orders (Pooja Ramesh Singh, Jul 2026)
hooks: Case: Pooja Ramesh Singh v J&K Bank (2026)
items.fact: Early Jul 2026: SC (P. S. Narasimha, Alok Aradhe JJ), Pooja Ramesh Singh v Jammu and Kashmir Bank Ltd — NCLT/NCLAT orders admitting a s. 7 IBC application set aside for relying on non-existent AI-generated precedents; "no decision in law"; AI only an aid under human control; s. 7 application restored
items.sources: SCC Online blog, Supreme Court July 2026 (5 Aug 2026)

items.label: Art 136 not a regular appeal — Chaitanya Baghel bail upheld (Jul 2026)
hooks: Case: Bihar Legal Support Society v CJI (1986)
items.fact: Late Jul 2026: SC (CJI Surya Kant, Joymalya Bagchi, V. Mohana JJ) refused to interfere with Chhattisgarh HC bail to Chaitanya Baghel (liquor scam); SC not a regular appellate court (Bihar Legal Support Society 1986); Art 136 for exceptional cases of grave injustice; Art 136(2) excludes armed-forces tribunals
items.sources: Supreme Court Observer, Monthly Review July 2026

items.label: Sinner retains Wimbledon (12 Jul 2026)
items.fact: 12 Jul 2026: Jannik Sinner (Italy) beat Alexander Zverev (Germany) in the Wimbledon men's final — second straight Wimbledon title; Wimbledon oldest Grand Slam (1877), only one on grass, All England Club

items.label: 24-hour production clock runs from detention (SC, 5 Nov 2026)
items.fact: 5 Nov 2026: SC (Ujjal Bhuyan, Atul S. Chandurkar JJ), appeals from Tripura HC (NDPS bail) — 24 h for production before magistrate under Art 22(2) runs from actual detention (29 Sep 2025, 2 PM), not formal arrest; distinction "constitutionally unsustainable"; detention beyond 24 h without production → immediate release; magistrates to record time of detention; BNSS 58 (= CrPC 57)
items.sources: The South First 5 Nov 2026 (citing LiveLaw, Bar & Bench); LiveLaw headline 5 Nov 2026

items.label: COP31 opens in Antalya, Türkiye (9 Nov 2026)
items.fact: 9 Nov 2026: COP31 opened at Antalya Expo Center, Türkiye; COP31 President Murat Kurum ("Implementation COP"); Australia's Chris Bowen "president of negotiations" under a bilateral hosting deal; UNFCCC 1992, secretariat Bonn; COP30 Belém 2025

items.label: Startup India: ~2.62 lakh DPIIT-recognised startups (Nov 2026)
items.fact: PIB 9–10 Nov 2026 (National Entrepreneurship Day): ~2.62 lakh DPIIT-recognised startups; 25.36 lakh jobs; Fund of Funds for Startups ~₹28,254 cr to 1,475 startups; Startup India launched 16 Jan 2016 (National Startup Day); FFS run by SIDBI
items.sources: Legacy IAS PIB summary 10 Nov 2026 (PIB release 2334411) — approximate

items.label: Art 141 — law declared by SC binds all courts
items.fact: Art 141: law declared by the Supreme Court is binding on all courts within India (cf. 142 complete justice, 144 authorities act in aid, 137 review)
